news.headline: An incredible night when England heroes were made
news.desc: On a spine-tingling night of drama, emotion and pure theatre in one of sport's most atmospheric arenas, England delivered one of their greatest performances.

news.headline: Fifa decision on Balogun ban 'incomprehensible' - Uefa
news.desc: Uefa has strongly criticised Fifa's shock decision not to uphold Folarin Balogun's immediate suspension at the World Cup, calling it "unprecedented, incomprehensible and unjustifiable".

news.headline: The man England will fear most - Haaland fires Norway to history
news.desc: Erling Haaland has scored seven goals in four World Cup games and he is the striker that nobody wants to face as he fires Norway into an historic quarter-final.

news.headline: Henderson injures wrist in England celebrations
news.desc: England midfielder Jordan Henderson suffered a "really bad" while celebrating his side's World Cup win over Mexico, head coach Thomas Tuchel says.

news.headline: Neymar says Brazil career over after Norway defeat
news.desc: An emotional Neymar says his international career for Brazil is "over" following his side's exit at the 2026 World Cup at the hands of Norway.

news.headline: Who produced another iconic performance? England player ratings
news.desc: BBC Sport England reporter Alex Howell rates how the Three Lions players performed in the last-16 win over Mexico.

news.headline: Where does Mexico win rank among England's best results?
news.desc: BBC Sport looks at some of England's most famous away victories after their epic win against Mexico at the Azteca - plus you can have your say.

news.headline: How Mexico's World Cup run brought joy after a year of fear
news.desc: For Mexico's football-loving community, the World Cup has been a triumph, despite their last-16 exit. The joy has spread to Southern California, home to one of the largest Mexican communities outside Mexico.

news.headline: 'Iconic match at iconic stadium' - England win down to 'pure will'
news.desc: England are praised for showing "heart and belief" as they beat Mexico in an "iconic match at an iconic stadium" to reach the World Cup quarter-finals.

news.headline: World Cup referees are just not good enough - Tuchel
news.desc: England head coach Thomas Tuchel says referees at the World Cup "are just not good enough" after the dramatic last-16 win over Mexico.

news.headline: Ageing Brazil need major surgery - but is Ancelotti the man to do it?
news.desc: There was nothing unlucky about Brazil's loss to Norway in the last 16 of the World Cup and their exit at this stage is an unmitigated disaster, writes Tim Vickery.

news.headline: England into quarter-finals - what is their path to the final?
news.desc: BBC Sport takes a look at what England will need to do to reach the final after progressing the quarter-finals.
